apps.localizedDescription:
Hand Tracker:

Real-time tracking of both hands from a webcam (MediaPipe Hands, 21 landmarks per hand), with a live 3D view, gesture and finger-curl readouts, motion capture export in 8 formats, video recording, and a video converter that opens nearly any video format and exports 36 formats. Runs as a Windows or Linux desktop app, an Android app, or in a browser.

Run it:

Windows app: double-click dist/HandTracker-1.1.0-portable.exe. Nothing to install; it works offline.

versions.localizedDescription: Built from f9a2a4a on main. Windows: HandTracker--portable.exe (no install). Mac: HandTracker--mac-arm64.dmg (Apple silicon) or HandTracker--mac-x64.dmg (Intel); the first time, open it from System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway. Linux: hand-tracker_amd64.deb (sudo apt install ./hand-trackeramd64.deb). Raspberry Pi 4/5 and other 64-bit ARM Linux: hand-trackerarm64.deb. Android: HandTracker-.apk. iPhone and iPad: HandTracker--ios-unsigned.ipa, installed with Sideloadly or AltStore and your Apple ID (re-install every 7 days with a free Apple ID). Chrome (the hand mouse for web pages): HandTracker--chrome-extension.zip, unzipped and loaded in chrome://extensions with Developer mode on (Load unpacked). Apps of their own, for each of these the same way: Hand Mouse (the hand mouse alone): HandMouse-; Remote Recording (controlling camera rigs, or being one): RemoteRecording-; Recording Converter (opening and converting recordings and videos): RecordingConverter-; on Linux hand-mouse.deb, remote-recording_.deb and recording-converter_*.deb.

privacy.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Hand Tracker reaches a computer's remote recording over Bluetooth when there's no network between them.
privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Hand Tracker follows your hands with the camera: tracking, recording, motion capture and the hand mouse.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Hand Tracker reaches the computers on your network that you control or record with.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Hand Tracker records sound with your videos, if you choose to.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Hand Tracker saves your recordings to Photos when you share them there.
